title: Gold Plus: Investment sweep feature explained
summary: This document explains the “Gold Plus” Investment sweep feature: sweeps are available and occur when your available balance exceeds a $50,000 evaluation threshold, moving only the amount above $50,000 to your linked investment account. If your balance is $50,000 or less, no sweep happens. You can review/manage sweep settings in the app and have periodic sessions to confirm the $50,000 threshold fits your liquidity needs.
